import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["TRANSACTIONS"].copy()

    # Preserve original dtypes/values for output columns
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_date", "txn_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Coalesce amount to 0 for running balance computation only
    amt_filled = df["amount"].fillna(0)

    # Running balance resets per account_id (cursor logic: bal resets when account changes)
    running_balance = amt_filled.groupby(df["account_id"]).cumsum()

    overdraft_flag = (running_balance < 0).astype("int64")
    # Match SMALLINT semantics (small integer), use int16-like values but keep as int
    overdraft_flag = overdraft_flag.astype("int64")

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "txn_seq": df["txn_seq"],
        "txn_date": df["txn_date"],
        "amount": df["amount"],
        "running_balance": running_balance.astype("float64"),
        "overdraft_flag": overdraft_flag
    })

    return {"acct_balance_flags": out}
